# v2.48-dev Release Notes

## New: Compliance Planning

Program dashboards tell you **where the gaps are**. Compliance Planning — a new
page under **Programs** — tells you **who to move, in what order, for the least
effort**, floating the easy wins to the top. It reuses exactly the same
distinct-holder counting as the dashboards, so the two never disagree.

### What it does

- **Pick a scope and one or more programs.** Choose Global / Theatre / Region /
  Country, then for each program aim at:
  - a **tier** (the tool picks the cheapest specialisations to get you there), or
    specific specialisation(s), for tiered programs; or
  - specific specialisation(s) or **all requirements**, for flat programs.
  Mixed selections are supported in a single plan (e.g. a tier in one program plus
  all specialisations in another).

- **Aggregate roadmap.** Each target shows a plain-language headline ("To reach
  *Gold* in *EMEA*: achieve 2 more specialisations — cheapest are A (3 moves, 2
  easy) and B (4 moves), plus 1 more delivery cert. ~8 people-moves.") and a
  breakdown per specialisation and requirement — have / need, the gap, and how many
  candidates sit in each tier.

- **"Who to move" drill-down.** One row per person listing every gap they close
  (expand for detail), ranked cheapest-first:
  - **Easy win** — did an ILT/OLX that leads to the required cert but never earned
    it; needs only the exam.
  - **Lapsed** — held the cert but it expired; needs only a renewal.
  - **Legacy upgrade** — holds a legacy cert whose replacement is the required one.
  - **Net-new** — needs the full ILT/OLX → cert path; reported as a remaining count.
  Because a person can only be **spent once**, candidates are allocated across the
  whole plan — so someone whose single exam closes the same cert in several places
  appears once, not once per gap.

- **Shared requirements.** A requirement authored *above* your selected scope
  (e.g. a theatre-wide requirement when planning one country) is flagged **shared**
  — your scope can contribute to it but can't close it alone.

- **Renewals at risk.** Holders whose qualifying training expires within a
  selectable window (1 / 3 / 6 / 12 months) are surfaced separately — their expiry
  will re-open a gap the plan currently reports as closed.

- **Export.** The candidate list and the renewals list can each be exported to
  CSV, Excel, or PDF.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- The existing program dashboards are unchanged — the planning engine reuses their
  shared compliance kernel read-only.
- Live view only in this release; saved plans and status tracking are planned for a
  later phase.
